notes.title: First Look Gameplay Trailer Revealed!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi all, how have you been?[/h3]

Today we are excited to reveal our [b]First Look Gameplay Trailer[/b] as seen at the [b]41st Golden Joystick Awards![/b]

In this new trailer we demonstrate how RESISTOR blends cinematic, character-driven storytelling with high-speed, stunt-infused racing as rising star Aster comes face to face with a dangerous pair of adversaries…   

We also introduce [b]character and vehicle customisation[/b], with an alternative look Aster, voiced by Thomas G Burt, jumping behind the wheel of several heavily modified refits of the R180 'STAGNUM' as it blazes across busy desert highways, threads the needle through a sprawling industrial complex, and navigates twisting subterranean tunnels.

[previewyoutube=edHR4UzN4yY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/85efb2448382d5dac2869ecc89214970a5c98b47.jpg[/img]

[h3]A LEGEND IN THE MAKING[/h3]

Utilise the [b]character creator[/b] to design your own racing prodigy, Aster. In true RPG fashion choose from a wide selection of body shapes, facial features, hairstyles, skin tones, and accessories, with MILLIONS of different combinations possible! Once you’ve settled on your look, pick out an appropriate voice type, with feminine and masculine vocal talents courtesy of Rhiannon Moushall (Warframe, CrisTales, Cloudpunk) and Thomas G Burt (SMITE, The Prince of Tennis, Phoenix Point).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/f7932cab513d5eb50d777282275ed7890068c9a5.gif[/img]

[h3]CUSTOM RIDE[/h3]

Retrofitted with a finely tuned, high-performance (and slightly unstable), Star Point Motors GT1200 plasma engine, Aster’s iconic red and white first-generation R180 was inherited from their father, the legendary racer Eugene Aster. While this powerful machine provides the perfect entry point for fledgling racers participating in the early stages of Dekker’s tournament, later challenges may require more ‘specialised’ hardware. [b]Collect new body kits and engine parts to modify the appearance and handling of your ride[/b] before hitting the track to dominate your rivals. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/326e60a948649f5cabb0dc13a98637b303cc0cc2.gif[/img]

[h3]RACING ON THE EDGE[/h3]

Aster’s road to victory begins in [b]The Northern Wastes[/b], a sparsely populated desert expanse littered with remnants of the old world and characterised by dusty highways, monolithic mesas, and treacherous gulleys. At the centre of these badlands stands ‘The Rig’, a decommissioned oil platform home to a small community of outcasts and traders. Here you will [b]accept your first missions[/b] allowing you to get to grips with the basics of stunt-racing and open-world exploration, while simultaneously making a name for yourself and [b]building up your rep[/b]. As Aster progresses through Dekker’s tournament new areas of the world will become available to explore, with increasingly more technical environments and tracks to tame!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/cd641dce5b5783c1145499995a33868d88b097a3.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy this first look, and we'll be back for another update soon!

Long Way Home & PQube

notes.title: First Playable Demo Announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We’ve got some exciting news to share with you, we’ll be bringing our [b]first playable demo[/b] of [b]RESISTOR[/b] to the [b]PQube booth[/b] at [b]EGX London on 12th – 15th October 23![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/4b9c269a2442e576e94b5bb750eece08238e7487.gif[/img]

In the demo, players will have the opportunity to create their own version of Aster using the [b]character creator[/b] and [b]learn the basics of racing[/b] by participating in a qualifying session in the lead-up to Dekker’s Tournament. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/0e6446ba9534015fb58357f334046500752b49d6.gif[/img]

They’ll then be able to practice the skills they have learned in the first major [b]open-world area[/b] of the game, [i]The Northern Wastes[/i], before heading over to [i]The Rig[/i] a decommissioned oil platform and a haven for the scattered communities that call the arid desert sands home.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232333/dd230248a79cb11a5626856ba4ce99237f6dab2f.gif[/img]

Can’t make it? No worries! We’re planning on [b]releasing a Steam demo soon[/b], so stay tuned for updates in the coming months.

Hopefully see you there!

Long Way Home & PQube
